# Briefing: what every piece of research should assume (orchestrator-maintained; each line has its source and date)

## The contest
- Sprint (1 Oct), Qualifier (10 Oct) and Grand Final (17 Oct) maps are all unseen; the ladder maps only set seeding.
  Anything tuned to a ladder map helps the ladder only (organisers, 2026-09-21..25).
- A tied knockout match sends the higher seed through; seeds come from the ladder rating, the Sprint's from the day
  before 1 Oct (lmkae, Admin, 2026-09-21/23). Qualifier submissions close 9 Oct.
- Organisers say later maps each teach a "lesson" and will stop "making the dragons for you"; more macro maps like
  Autarky and Dilemma are coming (rtrgrd, Admin, 2026-09-25).
